title: deer-flow.enrichment_feedback.error v1
description: Structured failure emitted by Deer Flow's EnrichmentFeedbackConsumer through BaseBusConsumer.emit_error when an inbound lifecycle event cannot be parsed or handled. The consumer keeps its loop alive after emitting this record.

consumer.description: Stable name of the consumer that encountered the failure.

event_channel.description: Inbound channel being handled when the failure occurred.

subject.description: CloudEvents subject when one was available to the consumer.

error_type.description: Machine-readable failure class, such as missing_bead_id, parse_error, or handler_error.
